   148  /**
   149   * Maps DeckGL class names (as stored in layer configs) to the canonical type
   150   * string used by buildDeckLayer's switch.
   151   * Add entries here when new DeckGL layer types are introduced.
   152   */
   153  export const DECKGL_TYPE_ALIAS: Record<string, string> = {
   154      GeoJsonLayer: 'vector',
   155      ScatterplotLayer: 'scatterplot',
   156      TileLayer: 'tile',
   157      BitmapLayer: 'tile',
   158      Tile3DLayer: 'tile3d',
   159      PointCloudLayer: 'pointcloud',
   160      MVTLayer: 'vectortile',
   161  }

   163  /**
   164   * Reads a nested value from a GeoJSON feature or plain object by dot-notation path.
   165   * Checks `.properties` first, then the object itself.
   166   * @param object - GeoJSON feature or plain data record.
   167   * @param path - Dot-notation key path, e.g. `"meta.score"`.
   168   */
   169  function getPropValue(object: unknown, path: string | undefined): unknown {
   170      if (!path || object == null || typeof object !== 'object') return undefined
   171      const source =
   172          (object as { properties?: Record<string, unknown> }).properties ??
   173          (object as Record<string, unknown>)
   174      return path
   175          .split('.')
   176          .reduce(
   177              (obj: unknown, key) =>
   178                  obj != null && typeof obj === 'object'
   179                      ? (obj as Record<string, unknown>)[key]
   180                      : undefined,
   181              source
   182          )
   183  }

   185  /**
   186   * Construct a deck.gl layer from a {@link LayerOptions} spec.
   187   * Supports `'tile'` (TileLayer + BitmapLayer), `'vector'` (GeoJsonLayer),
   188   * and `'pointcloud'` (PointCloudLayer).
   189   * DeckGL class names (e.g. `'GeoJsonLayer'`) are automatically normalised
   190   * via {@link DECKGL_TYPE_ALIAS}. Use `nativeOptions` for deck.gl-specific props.
   191   *
   192   * @throws {Error} If `options.type` is not a supported layer type.
   193   */
   194  function _toRgba(
   195      input: unknown,
   196      fallback: [number, number, number, number]
   197  ): [number, number, number, number] {
   198      if (Array.isArray(input) && input.length >= 3) {
   199          const [r, g, b, a] = input as number[]
   200          return [r, g, b, a ?? 255]
   201      }
   202      if (typeof input === 'string') {
   203          let s = input.trim()
   204          if (s.startsWith('#')) s = s.slice(1)
   205          if (s.length === 3) s = s.split('').map((c) => c + c).join('')
   206          if (s.length === 6 || s.length === 8) {
   207              const r = parseInt(s.slice(0, 2), 16)
   208              const g = parseInt(s.slice(2, 4), 16)
   209              const b = parseInt(s.slice(4, 6), 16)
   210              const a = s.length === 8 ? parseInt(s.slice(6, 8), 16) : 255
   211              if (!isNaN(r) && !isNaN(g) && !isNaN(b)) return [r, g, b, a]
   212          }
   213      }
   214      return fallback
   215  }
